announcements.title: Average Joe's CoD League
announcements.text:
We wanted to announce the release of our website! In the website you can see everything you need to know, including game settings for each mode! You can login with your discord and see your stats for the season via the COD-Stats website still or you can see the basic stats on the website itself.

The website shows schedules and updates in real time!


https://averagejoescodleague.com/

@everyone

Average Joe's is a COD league designed to give lesser skilled or new players a chance to compete in a competitive environment away from higher skilled players.

announcements.title: COD Stats - Call of Duty Stats Tracker, CDL Standings & Leagues
announcements.text:
@everyone
Hey all, we just wanted to let you know you can now track how many maps you played on the COD-Stats website! This link should take you right to it.

We also do recommend making an account for easier access, that way you can use the COD-Stats bot to see your stats in season straight from discord without having to go to the website.

If you do make an account make sure you use one of these referral codes:
Pizz, itz_inspire, MaRsH313, or Cam

https://cod-stats.com/amateur-leagues/average-joes-cod-league?season=__combines__&combine=5db987e0-947d-47db-9649-a41da6535dbf

Free Call of Duty stats tracker: CDL player K/D, live standings and results, plus amateur leagues, tournaments and Stat TrackR for competitive CoD.

@everyone #applications-and-szn-registration
Hey all! Season X registration is now OPEN! The link to the channel is above.

Once you get to the channel click on the dropdown and select "Season Registration". After you click on that you will receive a dm from the bot and just answer the questions. Once all the questions are answered you will will get one last dm from the bot saying you were registered and you will receive the registered role in the server. 

We cannot wait to see what MW4 has in store for us!

Thanks
-AJCL Staff
